question: Should an authorized maintainer pursue GitHub admin/support deletion for the scrubbed confidential pre-launch PR history?
rationale: The live PR body requests deletion, but repository code review and ClawSweeper automation cannot remove GitHub-hosted historical PR data.

options.title: Pursue GitHub deletion
options.body: Ask an authorized repository/GitHub admin or GitHub Support to remove the historical PR data if the remaining disclosure risk warrants it.

options.title: Leave closed and scrubbed
options.body: Accept the current closed, scrubbed state and take no further repository action.

recommendation.title: Pursue GitHub deletion
recommendation.body: Ask an authorized repository/GitHub admin or GitHub Support to remove the historical PR data if the remaining disclosure risk warrants it.
